meta._doc: Scout output. `items` is a dict keyed by sct_xx (resolved the same way detective items are, so verify.py can trace them). `live_status` is an array of dated, display-only real-world status records for the Analyst to join. Write incrementally.

sct_01.label: Short human-readable name
sct_01.filename: scout_messi.jpg   // for downloaded assets (image/video/audio). OMIT for embeds.
sct_01.embed_url: https://open.spotify.com/embed/...   // for kind=embed only; copied VERBATIM from a verified source.
sct_01.caption: Reader-facing caption as it should appear under the asset.
caption_claims: the factual assertions the caption makes that identity verification must back, e.g. 'this is Lionel Messi'
sct_01.retrieved_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when fetched, e.g. 2026-06-21T14:03:00Z

license.spdx: CC-BY-SA-4.0   // must be on license_allowlist.json to be re-hosted
license.attribution_text: Photo: <author> / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) — ready to drop into the References footer

identity.verified_title: what the proof returned, or one line of what you saw in the image
identity.subject: the real-world subject this depicts, or 'generic' for ambient/non-specific imagery

live_status.subject: what this status is about, e.g. 'Group C standings as of matchday 3'
live_status.status: the current real-world state — a short prose line or a small structured value
live_status.data_file: optional: path of the timestamped CSV/JSON the Analyst should join (e.g. code/live_status.csv)

_field_notes.kind: image / video / audio = a file in assets/ (use filename). embed = a platform player (use embed_url, never re-host).
_field_notes.embeds: For kind=embed: put the /embed/ player URL in embed_url and the watch/track URL you oEmbed-verified in source_url; set identity.method='oembed', identity.verified=true, and license.permits_republication=false (spdx may be 'All Rights Reserved'). The validate.py license gate skips embeds since they are not re-hosted.
_field_notes.license.permits_republication: Set true ONLY for assets you may legally re-host (license on the allowlist). Copyrighted tracks/clips → use kind=embed instead.
_field_notes.identity.verified: Hard requirement for real-subject media. validate.py fails any image/video/audio of a named person / specific place / specific object whose identity.verified != true.
_field_notes.purpose: INFORM (carries information the prose can't) or IMMERSE (sets mood, e.g. the BGM). Anything that is neither is decoration — don't add it.
_field_notes.live_status: DISPLAY-ONLY context, never training input. Each entry must carry a dated source (as_of + source.fetched_at) — that dated source is the traceability stand-in for a reproducible code line.
